title: draba aurea f. uber
intro: Draba aurea f. uber, commonly known as Golden Whitlow Grass, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties. Bioactive constituents present in Draba aurea f. uber include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
